_comment: Gateway Monitor configuration sample. Copy to config.json and fill in your values. NEVER commit config.json with real secrets to git.
_label: [NET-NEW] Configuration stub — no real secrets here

keyVault._comment: The SP client secret is stored in Key Vault. Collectors fetch it at runtime via Get-AzKeyVaultSecret. Never put the secret value here.

fabric._comment: workspaceId and lakehouse path are GUIDs from the Fabric workspace URL

gateway._logPathComment: Default path for PBIEgwService service account. Change if your gateway runs under a different service account.
gateway._spoolPathComment: [Assumption] Spool path — validate on Phase 5 pilot with Get-DataGatewayInfo (if SP 401 resolved)
gateway._outputPathComment: Local staging directory on gateway host where collectors write JSON before upload

scheduling._comment: Used to document cadence; actual scheduling via Windows Task Scheduler and Fabric Data Pipeline

alerting._offlineComment: Alert fires when no heartbeat received for this many minutes (default 10 = 2 missed 5-min intervals)
alerting._credDriftComment: Number of consecutive intervals datasource must be in Unknown/Error before alerting
alerting._errorRateComment: Gateway query error rate threshold (%) for error-rate-spike alert
alerting._networkComment: NIC utilization threshold (%) for network-saturation alert (v2, requires Collect-NetworkMetrics.ps1)
alerting._teamsComment: Optional: Teams webhook URL for alert notifications. Leave empty to disable.

networkMetrics._latencyComment: [Assumption] ICMP probe target as proxy for PBI relay latency. Validate target with your network team.

fpmBridge._comment: If true, 01_bronze_ingest.py reads FPM Eventhouse tables exposed as Delta via Eventhouse OneLake availability. Set enabled=true and provide the Delta path only if you have FPM deployed. Reference: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/fabric/real-time-intelligence/event-house-onelake-availability

features._networkComment: Enable Collect-NetworkMetrics.ps1 (v2 feature — requires NIC counter access)
features._refreshHistoryComment: Enable REST refresh history collection (v2 feature — requires Admin API access to dataset list)
features._activityEventsComment: Enable Power BI Activity Events collection for identity attribution (v3 feature)
